claimBoundary: A score of how unusual an event's light-curve shape is among the CTAS events with the same features in this release; it points at events worth a look and is not a classification, and it changes as the population changes.

parameters.drivers: the features with the most negative coniferest feature_signature contributions

features.definition: log10 of the half-maximum rise time (days)
features.name: log10HalfMaxRiseDays

features.definition: asinh(15-day decline rate / 0.01 mag per day)
features.name: asinhDecline15

features.definition: ZTF g - r at the fitted peaks (mag, not extinction-corrected)
features.name: peakGMinusR

parameters.neighbourMetric: Euclidean distance in the robustly scaled feature space
parameters.scaling: each feature minus its population median, divided by 1.4826 x its median absolute deviation
parameters.score: coniferest IsolationForest.score_samples (lower = more unusual); rank 1 = most unusual
